newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugoslav May RPI up 0.2 pct vs 0.1 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslav May RPI up 0.2 pct vs 0.1 pct in April.

text.p: The Federal Statistics Office reported the following economic indicator details. YUGOSLAV INFLATION MAY APRIL MAY 96
NOTES -- May RPI rose 18.1 percent against the 1996 average, and 3.3 percent against December 1996.
Cumulative January-May RPI was 27.5 percent up against the same five-month period 1996.
Figures refer to Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, comprising Serbia and Montenegro. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 4305
